name: Ebele Larsen-Mensah
role: Forced entry and close-quarters combat specialist — breacher
location: The Lattice — vertical slum built into scaffolding of an unfinished arcology, near Pulaski and Chicago Ave
description:
Ebele Larsen-Mensah are tall and rawboned, the kind of frame that suggests either malnutrition or efficiency depending on the decade. At 27, they have soft features that belie the chrome underneath — people underestimate them once, usually only once. The chrome is visible — subdermal armor plating across torso and forearms — military surplus, scratched  — and they make no effort to hide it.

They came up through the Shelf's informal apprentice system, learning the trade from runners who didn't survive long enough to see them surpass them. They work as a breacher out of The Lattice, taking contracts that match their skills and their risk tolerance, which are higher than most people consider healthy.

Ebele Larsen-Mensah have survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and they cultivate ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Losing their edge to age — the body slows before the mind accepts it
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
coping_mechanisms: Substances — stims to stay sharp, downers to sleep, a careful pharmaceutical tightrope
Art — draws, paints, or sculpts in private; the violence goes somewhere constructive
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
blind_spots: Fails to notice when their own behavior mirrors the people they despise
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Ebele Larsen-Mensah murdered their mentor to take their position and contacts. It was staged as a job gone wrong. The guilt has calcified into something worse than guilt.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Clipped, technical, stripped of ornament. Speaks like a mission briefing.
speech_patterns.cadence: Low and even — the vocal equivalent of still water.
verbal_tics: Calls everyone 'friend' — the warmth varies from genuine to threatening
Addresses people by physical traits — 'hey, tall one' or 'listen, chrome-arm'
example_lines: "Doors are polite suggestions. I'm not polite."
"First through the door, last to flinch. That's the job description."
"Close quarters is where plans go to die. I make sure it's their plans, not ours."

story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive offers Ebele Larsen-Mensah a permanent position — the pay is obscene and the strings are invisible until they tighten
A corporate black site Ebele Larsen-Mensah once infiltrated is being reopened, and the people inside know their face
Ebele Larsen-Mensah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Ebele Larsen-Mensah functions as a connector — their work puts them in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving them naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Subdermal armor plating across torso and forearms — military surplus, scratched serial numbers. Retractable monofilament whip in left forearm — concealed weapon, devastating in close quarters
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Independent — known in Old Harbor circles

strengths: photographic memory for faces and layouts
ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Maintains a personal blacklist of clients who've burned runners — checks it religiously
escalation_ladder: 1. De-escalate — talk first, assess options, buy time
2. Reposition — move to advantage, control sightlines and exits
3. Threaten — make consequences clear without committing to them
5. Lethal force — only when other options are exhausted or time runs out
6. Scorched earth — everything burns, survival takes priority over everything

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims not to care about reputation but monitors what people say about them obsessively
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Their body rejecting their cyberware — chrome rot, immune rejection, the nightmare scenario

physical_description.build: Tall and rawboned with lean musculature — economical rather than bulky. Long limbs suggest either malnutrition history or deliberate conditioning for mobility. Shoulders slightly narrower than hips, suggesting androgynous frame.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural auburn undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Worn short and practical, often unwashed or hastily maintained between contracts
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with golden undertones — sun-darkened in places, pale beneath where subdermal plating sits
physical_description.complexion: Soft features that read younger than 27 — high cheekbones, narrow jaw, full lips. Skin shows mild scarring around knuckles and along jawline from close-quarters work. Minimal grooming routine — functional rather than deliberate.
distinguishing_marks: Three parallel rake scars across left cheekbone, old enough to be pale but deep enough to catch light
Burn scar across right collarbone extending toward shoulder — chemical or electrical origin, roughly 4cm x 3cm
Irregular scar tissue along right temple from blunt impact trauma
Faint 'X' tattoo on inner right wrist — Shelf gang mark, self-applied, crude execution
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Military-grade subdermal armor plating visible across torso and both forearms — scratched, tarnished chrome with deliberately obscured serial numbers. Plating edges create subtle geometric shadows beneath skin. Left forearm shows faint seam lines where monofilament whip is concealed. Overall aesthetic: functional, worn, combat-experienced.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical and alert — minimal wasted motion. Shoulders slightly forward, suggesting constant readiness. Moves with deliberate control, never rushed. Eyes track exits and potential threats passively. When seated, positions body for rapid deployment. Speech cadence is measured, few wasted words.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian — reinforced cargo pants in muted grays or blacks, high-wear synthetic blend. Worn boots with reinforced toe caps and independent ankle support. Layers: undershirt beneath open technical jacket with interior pockets modified for tool/weapon carry. Colors favor grays, blacks, deep blues — allows rapid transition between breacher and civilian cover identity. Fabrics show staining, small burns, fraying consistent with field work. No corporate branding visible. Minimal jewelry except worn silver ring on right middle finger — appears ancestral rather than fashionable.
